title: Spiritual Warfare
definition: Spiritual warfare is the believer's ongoing battle against the world, the flesh, and the devil.
summary: The battle is real, but believers do not fight in their own strength. God provides truth, righteousness, faith, salvation, Scripture, prayer, and the power of Christ.
christFocus: Victory in spiritual warfare comes through Christ, His Word, His Spirit, and His finished work on the cross.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The battle is real, but believers do not fight in their own strength. God provides truth, righteousness, faith, salvation, Scripture, prayer, and the power of Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
